newsitem.title: MEXICO: Promex to sell stake, make stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Promex to sell stake, make stock offer.

text.p: Banca Promex plans a public stock offering and the sale of 20 percent of its shareholding capital to a foreign partner in order to finalize its purchase of Banco Union, the bank's president said on Wednesday.

Eduardo Carrillo Diaz, president of Grupo Financiero Promex Finamex, told journalists, "We have a commitment with the authorities to find a strategic partner to acquire 20 percent of the bank ... which will be foreign."
He also said Banca Promex, the banking subsidiary of Grupo Financiero Promex Finamex, "will raise 200 million pesos in the near future ... by a public share offering."
"Banca Promex, with the capitalization index of about 16 percent that we have right now, has some surplus capital which may be used to buy real estate," he added.

Promex on Monday acquired Banco Union, which was taken over by the Finance Ministry in September 1994 after evidence of fraud by its then-president Carlos Cabal Peniche, who is a fugitive from justice.
The Banco Promex purchase included 159 branches belonging to Banco Union.
